actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.role: President of Argentina, La Libertad Avanza Leader
actors.blurb: Milei is driving intense coverage as he pushes a sweeping reform of Argentina’s Central Bank charter, aiming to ban monetary financing of the state and redefine the bank’s mandate. His government is also navigating a shifting political strategy ahead of the 2027 elections, including alliances with provincial governors and internal party realignments. His declining approval ratings and controversial statements, such as mocking political opponents during the World Cup, keep him in the spotlight.

His efforts include proposing sanctions on nations that cooperate with the ICC and rallying international allies to isolate the court. His stance on the ICC and his role in U.S. foreign policy debates have made him a prominent figure in right-wing media coverage.

His influence on the UK’s political discourse and his role in shaping the far-right agenda continue to generate significant coverage.
